resources.string: If you are experiencing problems with CometOTP, please tap the button below to clear the cache and reset it.

When you clear the cache storage that has been occupied by CometOTP, we would still keep your accounts linked to CometOTP and there would be no loss of data because this process is totally safe as it doesn\'t tamper with the app data!
This process only clears the temporary files stored by CometOTP within your device storage.
After you clear the cache storage occupied by CometOTP, you may experience a slight one-time delay automatically loading back your accounts linked to CometOTP.
